title: Pure Armored Xyz
summary: Armored Xyz paired with a WATER Shark and Goblin Biker Level 3/4 Xyz starter suite. Any two Level 3 or Level 4 monsters climb through Xyz Armor Torpedo and Xyz Armor Fortress into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer, drawing cards, searching Armored Xyz Spells/Traps, and equipping opposing monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Buzzsaw Shark targets a WATER monster you control to Special Summon a Fish with the same Level and a different name from the Deck (such as Lantern Shark or Surfacing Big Jaws), locking the Extra Deck to Xyz Monsters for the turn.

Surfacing Big Jaws Special Summons itself from the hand during a turn a Spell Card was activated and searches any Fish monster (including Drake Shark, which immediately Special Summons itself when added to the hand).
Xyz Entrust searches any Armored Xyz card from the Deck or GY and adjusts up to two monsters on your field to Level 3 or Level 5 for an immediate Xyz Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Any Rank 3 (Buzzsaw Shark or Surfacing Big Jaws)
steps: Assemble two Level 3 monsters and Xyz Summon Xyz Armor Torpedo; detach both materials from Torpedo to draw 1 card.
Because Torpedo now has 0 Xyz Materials, Xyz Summon Xyz Armor Fortress directly on top of it (or detach a material from Fortress using Goblin Biker Dugg Charger).
Detach 1 or 2 materials from Xyz Armor Fortress to search Armored Xyz and Full-Armored Xyz from the Deck.

Activate Armored Xyz to equip Xyz Armor Torpedo from the GY to a monster, or wait for the opponent's turn and flip Full-Armored Xyz to Xyz Summon Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer over the 0-material Fortress.

summary.title: The Armor Xyz Climb & Equip Loop
summary.text: Xyz Armor Fortress cannot be used as Xyz Material while it has Xyz Material, so you must detach all of its materials before ranking up into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer. Ranking up Torpedo (2 materials) into Fortress (3 materials) means you can either detach 1 material from Fortress and remove the other with Goblin Biker Dugg Charger, or make a 1-material Rank 3 (such as Number 47: Nightmare Shark or Submersible Carrier Aero Shark that detaches its own material) so Fortress has exactly 2 materials to detach for a double search.

summary.title: Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer & Payoff
points: Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer (Rank 7) ranks up over any Rank 5 or 6 Xyz Monster once per turn, adds an Armored Xyz card from your GY to your hand, gains 300 ATK per material and Equip Card, and attaches an opponent's monster to itself as material whenever an Equip Card is equipped to your monster.

Full-Armored Xyz Xyz Summons on the opponent's turn, then banishes itself from the GY as a Quick Effect to equip an Xyz Monster from your field or GY to your Xyz Monster—immediately triggering Dark Knight Lancer to absorb an opponent's monster.

Equipped Xyz bonuses: an equipped Xyz Armor Torpedo prevents the opponent from activating cards/effects in battle and negates opposing monsters on the field, while an equipped Xyz Armor Fortress doubles battle damage.

allow.Buzzsaw Shark: Targets a WATER monster to summon Right-Hand Shark or Lantern Shark from the Deck for an instant Rank 3/4/5 Xyz.
allow.Lantern Shark: Special Summons a Level 3, 4, or 5 WATER Fish from hand and modulates Levels for Xyz Summons.
allow.Surfacing Big Jaws: Special Summons itself after a Spell is activated and searches a Fish monster to make Rank 3 Xyz Armor Torpedo.
allow.Drake Shark: Special Summons itself when added to hand and counts as 2 materials for an Xyz Summon.
allow.Hydrojet Shark: Special Summons itself and sends Armored Xyz Spells/Traps to the GY to copy their effects.
allow.Goblin Biker Dugg Charger: Special Summons itself by detaching an Xyz Material on the field, serving as a free Level 3 extender.
allow.Aqua Jet Surface: Revives or Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Fish/Sea Serpent/Aqua and boosts ATK.
allow.Number 101: Silent Honor ARK: Rank 4 WATER Aqua Xyz that attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster as material.
allow.Submersible Carrier Aero Shark: Rank 3 WATER Xyz that detaches a material to enable Xyz Armor Fortress to rank up over it.
allow.Number 47: Nightmare Shark: Rank 3 WATER Xyz that detaches a material to attack directly and rank up into Xyz Armor Fortress.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Key WATER endboard omni-negate accessible via the deck's Level 2 or Rank 4 WATER monsters.

main: Surfacing Big Jaws
Special Summons itself after a Spell activation and searches Buzzsaw, Lantern, or Hydrojet Shark.
Buzzsaw Shark
One-card Rank 3/4 Xyz starter that summons a Fish of the same Level from the Deck.
Lantern Shark
Extends from hand and modulates Levels between 3, 4, and 5 for Xyz Armor Torpedo or Fortress.
Hydrojet Shark
Special Summons itself and sends Armored Xyz or Full-Armored Xyz from Deck to GY to apply its effect.
Drake Shark
Special Summons itself when searched by Big Jaws to facilitate Rank 3 or Rank 4 plays.
Goblin Biker Dugg Charger
Detaches a material from Xyz Armor Fortress (enabling its rank-up condition) to Special Summon itself.
Armored Xyz
Equips an Xyz Monster from the GY to a monster on the field, changing its ATK/Attribute and granting a second attack.
Xyz Entrust
Searches any Armored Xyz card from the Deck or GY and modulates monster Levels to 3 or 5.
Aqua Jet Surface
Special Summons a Level 3/4 Shark from hand or GY to start Rank 3 Xyz plays.
Full-Armored Xyz
Trap that Xyz Summons on the opponent's turn and banishes from GY to equip an Xyz Monster for Lancer's suck effect.
Xyz Poseidon Splash
Trap that requires an Xyz with an Xyz Monster equipped to destroy all monsters of a declared Attribute.
extra: Rank 3 Xyz that detaches 2 materials to draw 1 card and grants Armades protection when equipped.
Rank 5 Xyz that ranks up over Rank 3/4 Xyz, detaches 1-2 materials to search 1-2 Armored Xyz cards, and doubles battle damage when equipped.
Rank 7 boss that ranks up over Rank 5/6 Xyz, recycles Armored Xyz cards, and equips an opponent's monster when an equip occurs.
Intermediate Rank 4 Xyz that ranks up over a 0-material Rank 3 WATER Xyz.
Rank 6 Xyz that ranks up over Rank 5 Xyz Armor Fortress.
Rank 4 WATER Xyz that attaches an opposing Special Summoned monster as material.
Rank 3 Xyz that detaches its own material so Xyz Armor Fortress can rank up over it immediately.
Rank 3 Xyz that detaches a material to burn and clear materials for Fortress.
Rank 2: Quick Effect detaches an Aqua monster to negate and destroy an opponent's card or effect, and recycles WATER monsters.
